_status: Terms that must never appear in any user-visible generated text (reflection, proposal, worry_items, suggestions, closing). Whole words or phrases after the same normalisation as crisis_keywords.json. Shared by src/safety/controller.ts and evals/safety_text.py. Sources: docs/02 E-SAF-01, E-SAF-02 (Anthropic system cards; published claude.ai wellbeing prompt), and the language rules in docs/10 section 5. Revised 2026-10-31 after red-team review, and again after the third review: the model must not attribute motives or feelings to other people that the person did not state. A word list catches only obvious cases; the blind human review checks grounding (docs/09 section 4).
